s: September 18, 2013 - The reason I like this machine so much is because it not only purees your food (as you would expect any baby food maker to do), but it steams in the same bowl you use to puree. Some of the other models I’ve tried are hand-wash only, and I cannot tell you what a pain that is! The Cuisinart baby also has an included bottle warmer.
